reply: Thank you for explaining that you were not told your forbearance had ended, and that you only learned of the delinquency from your credit report. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please keep records of any notices you did or did not receive, and dispute the delinquency with the credit reporting companies as well. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your $24,000.00 student loan payment was confirmed and posted, then reversed a few days later even though your bank details were correct. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep the confirmation email and your bank statement showing the payment, and ask in writing for the reason for the reversal. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you faxed your PSLF form before the deadline but the two agencies give conflicting answers about whether it was received. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep the fax receipt and a copy of the form, and ask in writing for confirmation that it was received on time. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you returned to school this semester but are receiving bills on your $3,500.00 loan, and that you cannot reach anyone by phone. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask your school to confirm your enrollment with your servicer, and send a written request for an in-school deferment. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your application has been pending for over a month and that you cannot get a date for when it will be processed. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep proof of when the application was received, and send a written request for its status and expected processing date. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your account was placed in an administrative forbearance you did not request, which may affect your progress toward PSLF. We understand your concern as a public school teacher. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask in writing for the forbearance to be reviewed and how it affects your qualifying payment count. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have paid your student loans without a break for many years, and want to know whether you qualify for forgiveness. We understand why this matters to you. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask in writing for a complete payment history, including payments made to your earlier servicer, and for the forgiveness options that may apply. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your IDR application showed a payment of $430.00, but your billed payment is much higher, and that your forms are delayed. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep the screenshot of the estimate and your submission date, and ask in writing for the status of your application. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your loans were shown as discharged under the settlement but now appear reconsolidated with a due date. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep the discharge notices and the new letter, and send a written request for the current status of each loan and the reason for the change. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your $1,000.00 lump-sum payment was applied to future months instead of reducing your principal. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. You can usually tell your servicer how to apply extra payments, so please send written instructions that extra amounts go to principal. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your SAVE application has been pending for months while you are billed a higher amount, and that you were told a payment was required before processing. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep proof of your application and payments, and ask in writing for its status. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that three $100.00 payments were reversed and that you were told you are responsible for the related fees. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep the confirmation numbers and your bank records, and ask in writing for the reason each payment was reversed and for a review of the fees. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that interest was capitalized when you changed repayment plans during the payment pause, when interest was set at 0%. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep the capitalization notice and the plan change records, and ask in writing for the capitalization to be reviewed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have made the required PSLF payments, but the tracker has not been updated after you resubmitted your employment forms. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep copies of each employment form and your payment records, and ask in writing for your payment count to be reviewed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your repayment plan change took over three months because of a technical issue, and that about $3,200.00 in interest accrued. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep your original submission date and notes of your calls, and ask in writing for a review of the interest during the delay. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you received a backdated billing statement for the second time, with less than two weeks before the due date. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep the statements and their arrival dates, and ask in writing to confirm your due date and whether late fees will apply. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your statements do not show the monthly interest on your $120,000.00 balance, making it hard to know how much to pay. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask in writing for the interest rate and daily interest amount for each loan, and keep your statements. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your borrower defense discharge was granted, and that you then received a refund check that seems incorrect without any explanation. We understand your confusion. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep copies of the check and the discharge notice, and ask in writing for a breakdown of the refund amount. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you are being billed for a consolidation loan you have no record of signing. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please send a written request for a copy of the signed consolidation application and promissory note, and keep your original loan documents. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your final PSLF form was received months ago, but your payment count has not been updated even after the stated processing time. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep the confirmation message, and ask in writing for the status of your form and the updated payment count. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you cannot log in to pay your student loan and that phone wait times are over an hour. We understand your concern about late reporting. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep screenshots of the login errors with the dates, and ask in writing for another way to make your payment on time. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your account shows you as delinquent during the pandemic payment pause, which is affecting your home purchase. We understand the urgency. Your complaint has been logged for urgent review by the credit reporting team. Please keep any records of the pause on your account, and dispute the delinquency with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that only $180.00 of your $250.00 payment was applied, and that one loan received nothing. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep your bank statement and balance screenshots, and send a written request for the full $250.00 payment to be traced and applied. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were told your new payment amount would be processed within 10 days, but nothing has changed. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep the date and details of your call, and send a written request for the status of your payment change. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you asked for the SAVE plan but were placed on the ICR plan with higher payments. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep a copy of your application showing the plan you chose, and ask in writing for your plan to be corrected. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you need to end your forbearance but cannot reach anyone, and that calls drop without a callback. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please send your request to end the forbearance in writing through the servicer's website or mail, and keep a copy. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you cannot log in to your account after your loans were transferred, even after resetting your password. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep screenshots of the error message, and ask in writing for your online account to be checked or reset. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have asked for years about $2,200.00 in capitalized interest and a 90-day late report while on autopay. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep your autopay records, send a written request for an explanation, and dispute the late report with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your recertified payment was accepted, but your account was then placed in a forbearance you did not request, costing you a PSLF month. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask in writing for the forbearance to be reviewed and its effect on your qualifying payments. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your $25.00 monthly payment on an income-based plan covers only interest, so your balance does not go down. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask in writing about your plan's forgiveness timeline and whether other plans would suit you better. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
